0.text: Her doctor or a dietitian should set that, since it depends on her medication and sugar levels. In general, balanced plates with dal, sabzi and protein, smaller rice or roti portions and walking after meals help, but her doctor's advice comes first.

I won't pick a brand, but under 2000 look for at least 24 g protein per 30 g scoop, a third-party lab test report and an FSSAI licence, and skip ones with added amino acids padding the protein number. A 1 kg tub covers about 33 scoops.
